_source: USDA SCS/NRCS Technical Release 55, Urban Hydrology for Small Watersheds, Second Ed., June 1986, Table 2-2b 'Runoff curve numbers for cultivated agricultural lands' (p. 2-6). Footnote 1: average runoff condition, Ia = 0.2S. Footnote 3: good hydrologic condition = factors encourage infiltration (e.g. residue cover >= 20%).
_limitations: Curve numbers describe average conditions for design; accuracy decreases for historical storms and for runoff below 0.5 in; snowmelt and rain on frozen ground are not covered (TR-55 chapter 2, Limitations).
